_comment: A3 PRIORITY PROPAGATION (operating-layer Phase C). The cycle's priority, written where scripts/ops/render_session_brief.py renders it into CLAUDE.md -- the only surface that reaches a session before its first tool call. THE CHANNEL ALREADY WORKED; nothing wrote a priority for it to carry, so a decision taken with the operator reached the next session only if a human retyped it. That is the gap this file closes, and the whole of it. ⚠️ IT DOES NOT MAKE ANYONE FOLLOW THE PRIORITY -- it removes the excuse of not knowing it. Do not describe it as enforcement. ⚠️ `current` may be null: NO PRIORITY SET and RENDERER BROKEN must never render identically, so the renderer prints an explicit line for null rather than falling silent. Editing this file changes CLAUDE.md's generated brief -- re-render with `python3 scripts/ops/render_session_brief.py --write`, never by hand-editing the block.

current.priority: Stand up the operating layer's STEERING half. The system built EXECUTION and INTEGRITY to a high standard and never built the steering: of 24 declared functions, 5 work, 14 are partial and 5 are missing outright, and all five missing ones are steering.
current.why: Measured 2026-09-01 across the working tree, populations stated in the design series: backlog net +425 rows in August against +37 in May; 196 dated sprint logs of which 1.0% deployed to real money; 256 of 370 research units superseded before anyone read them; 1 of 117 dispositions producing an action; 21 of 32 milestones simultaneously active. The root cause is not rigour or effort -- both are strong -- it is that nothing removes anything.
current.what_it_means_for_a_session: Prefer work that makes the system steer over work that makes it execute better. If you are about to start something that is neither the current phase nor pulled by a held-up stage, that is the thing to re-argue before starting it.
current.basis_note: DECIDED, not MEASURED. The operator directed the operating-model redesign on 2026-09-01; the measurements above are the evidence that informed it, not the derivation of it. E1 constraint diagnosis does not exist yet, so this priority is operator-set rather than computed -- which is a legitimate source (A2 priority is operator-set by design) but a DIFFERENT one, and recording it as a constraint finding would be the unprovenanced conclusion this repo keeps paying for.
current.review_cadence_note: Weekly, matching the intent's review_cadence. Past review_by the renderer marks it STALE rather than dropping it: a priority nobody re-affirmed is still the last thing decided, and hiding it would be worse than showing it with its age.
